message: Function has multiple exit doors — use single-exit control flow

evaluator_config.message_template: Function '{name}' has {count} exit doors — use single-exit control flow

rationale: Multiple exit points create invisible control flow. A reviewer must trace every path to understand what the function returns. A single exit makes the return value the function's explicit contract. Exit doors include return, raise, yield, yield from, pass, and process-terminating calls (sys.exit, os._exit, exit, quit). All functions and methods MUST have at most one exit door — no exceptions.
remediation: Refactor to a single terminal exit. Prefer a continue-flag / staged assignment pattern with one return (or one yield for generators).
